results.name: Policy question

turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent:
No, we cannot buy them from this supplier. 

Under Purchase Policy §6.2 (POL-PUR-001 §6.2) and Supplier Policy §4.1 (POL-SUP-003 §4.1), parts that come into contact with food—including 5-litre silicone gaskets (GSK-SIL-05L)—may only be purchased from suppliers holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Even if their price is lower, an order cannot be placed until a valid certificate is uploaded and verified.

clauses.document: Purchase Policy v4.1
clauses.heading: 6. Supplier qualification
clauses.text: 6.2 **Parts that come into contact with food** (gaskets, lids, body blanks and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a **valid food-grade certificate** on file in Bahi. clauses.document: Supplier Policy v2.3
clauses.heading: 4. Food-grade certificates
clauses.text: 4.2 The certificate must be a test report from a laboratory accredited for food-contact materials (for example an FSSAI-notified laboratory), or a BIS conformity certificate for stainless steel grade 304 or better.

clauses.heading: 4. Food-grade certificates

clauses.status: in force until 2026-11-30; replaced from 2026-12-01 by AMD-PUR-2026-03 §1.1

clauses.document: Bahi ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3
clauses.heading: 11. Purchase order entry (PUR-PO-01) › 11.9 The status after saving
clauses.text: If the cost centre is closed, the order is saved as DR (Draft) with warning W-CC-114, and nothing is sent to anyone. If the gross value is within your limit, the order is AP (approved). results.name: Policy question

turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent:
No, we cannot buy them from that supplier.

Under Rasoi's purchase policy (POL-PUR-001 §6.2) and supplier policy (POL-SUP-003 §4.1), parts that come into contact with food—specifically including gaskets—may only be purchased from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Even if their price is lower, the certificate must be uploaded and verified before any order can be placed.

clauses.text: Open the order, check it and press Approve with an optional comment. The status becomes AP. You cannot approve an order you created (ERR-APR-0003), one above your limit (ERR-APR-0004), or one that is not pending approval (ERR-PO-0702).

clauses.heading: 11. Purchase order entry (PUR-PO-01) › 11.9 The status after saving
clauses.text: If the cost centre is closed, the order is saved as DR (Draft) with warning W-CC-114, and nothing is sent to anyone. If the gross value is within your limit, the order is AP (approved). clauses.heading: 12. Purchase order approval (PUR-POA-04) › 12.3 Rejecting an order
